newsitem.title: PORTUGAL: Portugal fires management of state-owned railways.
newsitem.headline: Portugal fires management of state-owned railways.

text.p: The Portuguese government has fired the management board of state-owned railways Caminhos de Ferro Portugueses (CP), cabinet spokesman Vitalino Canas said on Thursday.
The decision, which followed disagreements between the government and management linked to the restructuring of CP, had been made earlier but was officially passed at Thursday's cabinet meeting.
The government named Manuel Antunes Frasquilho as the new CP president.
The railway lost 59.8 billion escudos ($380.6 million) in 1995, partly as a result of increased investment costs, compared with a loss of 48.4 billion the previous year.
The government has plans to privatise some CP services.
